requiredActions: Record the requester-approved development exception separately from production readiness; do not treat this DRAFT as an immutable READY handoff.

Remove legacy Performance Mongo adapter/constants and setup/seed mappings. Read only the three named collections in the approved development database, with explicit country/environment/identity guards and no data fallback.
Import only sanitized supplied files using the exact BSON schemas, with dry-run, duplicate/conflict checks, transactional inserts and no deletes or overwrites.
Translate approved production/MAPA/persistency mock mappings into unchanged C2 1.4.0/C3 shapes; preserve 2025 reporting windows and 2026 refresh dates. Keep disjoint agents separate.

Retain static catalogue/config and volatile preferences. Missing history/milestones/recommendations are empty; feedback cannot invent a recommendation. Retire the obsolete cross-domain synthetic seeder without changing Contest runtime/storage.
Test AC-PA-DIRECT-01 through AC-PA-DIRECT-11, build and verify live local APIs. Publish only a non-COMPLETE receipt while Spec/implementation are uncommitted and production approvals remain open.

For 0.3.0, harden existing resident-data reads per AC-PA-DIRECT-18 through AC-PA-DIRECT-24: schema-verified mapping table, exact BSON/numeric-text handling, controlled no-data 404, sanitized metadata errors, fixed default database and optional independent Performance URI. Do not import, seed, alter validators or remove authentication guards.

For 0.4.0, route by businessLine to the correct database (INSURANCE/ALL both in pa_performance_PAMB-dev; TAKAFUL in the new pa_performance_PBTB-dev), replacing the prior businessLine/basis EMPTY gate. Replace MONGODB_PERFORMANCE_DB with MONGODB_PAMB_DB and MONGODB_PBTB_DB; do not touch the unrelated MONGODB_DB variable. Add the agent-status filter (accepting both Active and A, temporary pending upstream data correction). Change asOfDate to derive from period fields, never asOnDate (AC-PA-DIRECT-29). Drop asOnDate/audit.updatedAt from the per-collection sort tie-break, keeping only id/_id descending (AC-PA-DIRECT-30).

For 0.5.0 (corrects 0.4.0, then reverted the filter-field part within the same round): field casing is camelCase (agentId/agentAggregation/agentStatus/agentType/caseStatus) in every collection in both databases; PBTB's 6 real my_production documents were renamed from snake_case to match, with requester sign-off — this part stands. The businessLine filter was first moved from entity to agentType (entity never varies within a database, so the entity-based rule always returned zero rows for ALL), then reverted: real Hybrid-licensed agents (e.g. 1136911, 1002809) have only an agentType 'HYBRID' row, not a separate 'PAMB' one, so a strict agentType filter 404s them under INSURANCE. INSURANCE/ALL now both filter on entity: 'PAMB' (same record per agent, interim) pending data-team confirmation of the intended two-record shape; TAKAFUL filters on entity: 'PBTB'. Test AC-PA-DIRECT-31 through AC-PA-DIRECT-33 (entity-based, interim) in place of superseded AC-PA-DIRECT-25 through AC-PA-DIRECT-27; AC-PA-DIRECT-28's casing clause is corrected, its Active/A rule unchanged.
Implement the explicitly configured development-only sample selector and initial lenses in direct-mock-profile.md 0.2.0. Preserve existing fixed-agent headers and unrelated frontend changes.
Use matching configured identities for production/MAPA/persistency across dashboard and detail. Never join disjoint agents, rewrite ALL to INSURANCE in a request wrapper, or fabricate values.
Reuse existing select styling and the five domain-owned i18n keys. Keep standard/offline persona behavior and all C2/C3 shapes unchanged.
Test AC-PA-DIRECT-12 through AC-PA-DIRECT-17 with unit and real browser checks; record Draft/non-COMPLETE evidence only. Production builds must exclude development sample configuration.
